description: A caption that outgrows its control by a wide margin has to be given room. Both of these are taken from a real application: a button whose Spanish caption needs roughly twice its width, and a small label used as a heading whose caption needs nearly twice its own. Neither is a borderline case that a point of font reduction would settle. The planner produced no proposal at all for either of them - not a width, not a height, not a font - so both drew over their neighbours in the running application while the analysis reported nothing to fix.
